subject.title: fix(agent): treat Anthropic long-context usage errors as context overflow for compact+retry

question: Should this PR complete compact-then-fallback behavior after bounded overflow recovery is exhausted, or should OpenClaw intentionally accept compaction-only handling for this Anthropic 429?
rationale: Both paths are product-valid and affect existing provider routing plus session-state behavior; automation cannot safely choose between preserving configured fallback after compaction exhaustion and documenting this error as compaction-only.

options.title: Complete Compact Then Fallback
options.body: Keep the classifier, then emit a failoverable terminal outcome only after compaction and truncation are exhausted and prove the next configured candidate is selected safely.

options.title: Accept Classifier-Only Compaction
options.body: Merge the narrow classifier change only if maintainers intentionally accept that this exact Anthropic 429 no longer uses configured model fallback after exhausted compaction.

options.title: Hold For Broader Fallback Policy
options.body: Keep this PR open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/9986 settles the generic post-overflow fallback contract.

recommendation.title: Complete Compact Then Fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the classifier, then emit a failoverable terminal outcome only after compaction and truncation are exhausted and prove the next configured candidate is selected safely.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned and wrote the current changes-requested review that defines the unresolved compact-then-fallback shape.
